scope: Host-side gates attached to the retired Workbench boot-overlay product carrier; hardware-only acceptance remains in the hardware protocol.

entries.reason: The L65M boot overlay, its eval_init/defprim entry chain and its single resident inbound edge do not exist in C2.
C2 replaces the old resident-symbol allowlist with section-qualified lifetime, ownership, facade and capacity gates.
This still-live emitted-code property was orphaned when the Workbench carrier retired; Link 33 hardware exposed the loss.
The guarded F011 write path remains product code and its final linked instruction window must be remeasured for every C2 identity.
The L65M stage descriptor and combined preload are retired; C2 boot records are self-describing L65R-v2 records with publish-last identity.
C2 packs boot and session families independently and binds every record and payload after the sole product link.
The old Bank-0 boot-overlay gap model is retired; C2 measures all five resident walls and both lifetime-exclusive runtime banks from WPLTO output.
WPLTO is not claimed to be a pure function across invocations. The current contract pins the one built identity, its evidence and the 34-byte publish-last domain instead of claiming rebuild identity.
The smoke executes the removed vm_boot_overlay implementation. C2 boot execution is covered by its own target decoder tests and hardware presmoke rather than a false compatibility host path.
Hardware stack and boot behavior cannot become a structural link claim; its successor remains an explicit hardware protocol line after each new product identity.
